subject: Infosec gating criteria & evidence lane
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara@clearlimit.com>, Tom Jensen <tom.jensen@clearlimit.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Infosec gating criteria & evidence lane

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap from our side and the concrete next steps so procurement and security have an artifact lane to work down. I captured the pain points and acceptance criteria we discussed; please flag anything I missed.

Pain points you highlighted:
- Need for audit log access (per-tenant, real-time or near real-time exports) for fraud ops.
- Explicit retention controls and an exportable retention table for legal/records.
- SOC 2 evidence + timelines for control mappings.
- A defined pen test window and scope before production cutover.

Goals you shared:
1) Proof that logs and retention meet regulator expectations by June 1 (target go-live dependent on evidence).
2) Minimal change to data residency; prefer us-east region with VPC-only control plane.
3) Clear contract clauses around DPA and data retention / deletion proof.

Mutual action items (proposal):
- Ben (me): Share a SOC 2 summary (control mappings) + pen test scope and a proposed retention CSV by EOD Thu (attached).
- Grace: Draft language for the DPA retention clause and list any SLA exceptions we should pre-approve (internal).
- Sara: Confirm the list of internal roles that need log access & approval cadence for evidence review.
- Tom / Procurement: Share procurement timeline and any required PO/accounting steps.

Attachments included: SOC2_summary.pdf, pen_test_scope.docx, data-retention-table.csv

Proposed pen-test windows (we can be flexible): week of 5/10 or week of 5/24. Which do you prefer?

Next meeting: suggest a 30-min sync for evidence handoff on Friday 4/9 or Monday 4/12 — open to what works for your team.

Short ask: Reply with the preferred pen-test week and who from your security/procurement teams will be the primary reviewer.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

From: Sara Liu <sara@clearlimit.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Jensen <tom.jensen@clearlimit.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Infosec gating criteria & evidence lane

Ben — thanks for the thorough recap. This aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications / asks from our side: 

1) Audit logs: we need an export that includes request metadata and model_id for at least 90 days, with an optional 1-year retention for high-risk cases. Is real-time streaming to our S3 an option or only periodic exports?

2) SOC 2: we absolutely need the control mapping to AWS and Redwood controls for Change Management and Logging. If you can map control IDs, that will speed our review.

3) Pen test scope: we prefer the week of 5/24 to give our internal team time to review the scope.

4) Procurement timeline: procurement@clearlimit.com gets looped for contract and PO. Targeting a signed DPA + MPA by 5/31 if evidence looks good.

I attached our internal evidence checklist (attached inline) — high level: control mapping, retention proof, network topology diagram, and any 3rd-party subprocessor list.

Two quick asks: can you provide a short example log export (redacted) and a sample DPA clause on retention so we can run it past legal?

Thanks,
Sara Liu
Head of Security & Compliance | ClearLimit Inc.
sara@clearlimit.com | +1 (617) 555-2198

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Infosec gating criteria & evidence lane

Sara — great, thanks for the fast responses and the checklist. Looping in next steps and what we'll deliver.

Quick answers to your asks: 
- Log export: we support both near-real-time streaming to customer S3 buckets (via secure presigned uploads) and scheduled exports. We'll include a redacted sample export in the bundle.
- SOC 2 mapping: attached SOC2_summary.pdf maps our controls to SOC criteria and calls out the Change Management and Logging controls.
- DPA clause: Grace is drafting suggested language and will share a DPA snippet tomorrow.

Confirmed: Pen test window = week of 5/24. We'll provision a canary environment and provide the exact topology.

Mutual action plan (updated):
- By 4/8 EOD (Ben): Send SOC2_summary.pdf, pen_test_scope.docx, data-retention-table.csv (sent) + redacted log export sample (to follow tomorrow).
- By 4/9 (Sara): Provide the list of log consumers and legal contact for DPA review.
- By 4/16 (Grace / internal): Draft DPA retention language and annotate any SLA exceptions; provide to Sara for review.
- By 5/10: Provide final topology for pen test prep.
- Week of 5/24: Pen test execution (live).
- Target 5/31: Signed DPA + MPA (if evidence accepted).

If anything needs to move earlier, flag it — we're happy to accelerate the redacted export and sample retention proof.

Thanks again, looking forward to keeping momentum.

Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara@clearlimit.com>, Tom Jensen <tom.jensen@clearlimit.com>, procurement@clearlimit.com
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Infosec gating criteria & evidence lane

Ben / team —

Thanks for pulling this together. Internal confirmation: I will draft the DPA retention snippet and include two options — (A) 90-day default retention with on-demand 1-year retention for tagged accounts, and (B) 1-year retention as the default (higher cost). I'll also call out a hard delete proof artifact (S3 deletion logs + delete-confirmation event) so legal has an auditable record.

Action items I own (deliver by 4/16):
- DPA retention text + commentary on cost/ops impact.
- List of SLA exceptions we recommend pre-approving for ClearLimit (latency percentile exceptions for large batch exports).
- A short memo describing how we provide redacted sample logs and the controls around redaction.

Ben — please confirm we will: share the redacted log sample by 4/9 EOD and the detailed pen test topology by 5/10. That will let me finish the DPA language with concrete artifact references.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com | +1 (212) 555-0187
